printed_edition: Madarij al-Salikin, volume 2, Nabil ibn Nassar al-Sindi, 2019
scope: Second-round source correction of previously unresolved page 24 Quran 16:20 reading and associated Russian pronoun; separately inspected p319 remaining problematic source excerpt. This is not full 657-page print-scan certification.

confirmed_edits.issue: Electronically extracted edition printed وَالَّذِينَ الَّذِينَ ... instead of the recognized qira'a وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ; Russian had third-person 'они призывают' inconsistent with second-person 'تَدْعُونَ'.
confirmed_edits.old_arabic_excerpt: {وَالَّذِينَ الَّذِينَ ... مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ} [النحل: ٢٠]
confirmed_edits.corrected_arabic_excerpt: {وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئًا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ} [النحل: ٢٠]
confirmed_edits.russian_old: Те, кого они призывают помимо Аллаха
confirmed_edits.russian_new: Те, к кому вы взываете помимо Аллаха
confirmed_edits.justification: 2019 edition footnote 3 (p.24) explicitly records the ta' reading as majority qira'a (other than Asim and Yaqub), and a separate edition-indexed copy of p.24 prints 'وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ'. Quranpedia 16:20 readings confirms ta' vs ya' forms. Do not normalize to Hafs ya' because target edition's cited reading uses ta'.
confirmed_edits.remaining: Verify page image of selected edition and independent expert signoff before print-scan-verified status.

inspected_without_edit.issue: Electronic transcription in 22:30 ends quotation after 'وَأُحِلَّتْ', which is a mid-clause fragment; selected-edition page image not yet visually checked.
inspected_without_edit.action: Do not invent a complete original excerpt or falsely certify the quote; retain pending visual print collation.
